fusions.name: Storm-Driven Stampede
fusions.desc: Rushes to an enemy up to 6 tiles away and tramples, which deals 12 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

fusions.name: Bellwether's Run
fusions.desc: Charges a target up to 5 tiles away and butts it, which deals 26 damage and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds. If it hits, every ally deals 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Backs to the Gale
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 12 seconds, and pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Plodding On
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you regain 4 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
